page.text:
## Re-Elect Linda Granger for Chabot-Las Positas Trustee
|
Throughout my 31 years of service in public education, I have always believed in the importance of creating an environment that supports every student. As a current Chabot-Las Positas Trustee, I have remained focused on developing and maintaining systems that support student success, focusing on a culture that fosters diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging, and expanding opportunities that support workforce development and skillset advancement.
I’m running for re-election to continue the progress we have made and to continue uplifting and supporting our community colleges. I hope you will take some time to learn more about me, my priorities, and my accomplishments. I would be honored to receive your vote!
-Linda Granger
